subject: RFP bake-off: proposed credit tilt & allocation for HealthA pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@healtha.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healtha.com, demos@healtha.com
Date: 2026-12-02T14:32:00Z
Subject: RFP bake-off — request for extended credits and timing

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re lining up a three-vendor bake-off for our clinical summarization RFP (deliverable: structured clinical note extraction + latency targets). We have a tight 3-week evaluation window and need predictable throughput for parallel tests.

Two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood extend the trial credits to cover the three-week bench (we estimated ~2M tokens across teams) and 2) can you provide a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a runbook for model variants so our infra team can automate the runs?

Procurement is fine with a conditional credit allocation but will need a short note on data retention and export controls to attach to our vendor packet.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Sr. Manager, ML Ops
HealthA

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@healtha.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — request for extended credits and timing

Hi Samantha — great to hear the timing and scope. We can support a 3-week evaluation and propose the following:

- Credit allocation: 2.25M tokens total (split as 1.0M for week 1, 0.75M for week 2, 0.5M buffer)
- MAP: 6 checkpoints (kickoff, baseline run, integration run, performance sweep, acceptance smoke, wrap)
- Runbook: we’ll hand over a runnable DAG + sample infra YAML for your CI to hit our hosted endpoints; we can also provide a dedicated token with per-route quotas to isolate the bake-off traffic.

A couple of quick asks: to qualify for the full 2.25M tilt allocation we need a short vendor parity clause in the MAP — essentially confirmation that competitors’ runs will be in the same test harness (same dataset, sequence lengths, and allowed model variants). If HealthA prefers, we can provide a smaller, unconditional grant of 1.2M tokens.

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a provisional credits CSV. Ben/Logan — looping you in to confirm approval path + any procurement constraints.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0163

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_HealthA.pdf (draft), credits_distribution.csv

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:14:00Z
Subject: Internal — approval request: HealthA bake-off tilt credits (2.25M)

Ben / Logan — need quick approval and any gating notes. Key points:
- Customer: HealthA (clinical summarization RFP)
- Request: 2.25M token allocation (conditional on parity in MAP) vs fallback 1.2M unconditional
- Timeline: kickoff week of Dec 7, 3-week run, acceptance by Dec 28
- Conditions we should enforce: limited to hosted API endpoints, no token rollup beyond the bake-off project, data retention TTL 30 days, and redaction of PHI per our policy (HealthA will sign the short PO).

Reasoning: this is a three-vendor head-to-head with a potential Dedicated sale if they like latency SLOs. 2.25M priced as promotional credits — won’t affect committed revenue but helps get telemetry and a clear champion.

Could you confirm by EOD? If legal/procurement needs to be looped, I can forward the MAP and the redaction note.

Ava

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal — approval request: HealthA bake-off tilt credits (2.25M)

Thanks Ava — I approve the conditional 2.25M allocation with the following provisos:
1) Apply a per-route quota and strict TTL on any stored logs (30 days).
2) Credits to be disbursed in three tranches as you outlined; finance will tag this as promo credit (non-refundable).
3) No competitor exclusivity language in our contract; we can require the same harness but cannot restrict who they test.
4) Legal should sign off on the redaction procedures; loop in legal if HealthA has PHI-specific clauses.

Looping in Logan for operational confirmation that we can provision the dedicated token with the required quotas and a dashboard view for their team.

-Ben

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@healtha.com>, procurement@healtha.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-15T09:11:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP bake-off — final credit allocation & MAP

Hi Samantha — quick update and confirmation:

We’ve approved the conditional promotional allocation of 2.25M tokens for the HealthA bake-off. Attached is the final MAP and the credits CSV with tranche dates. Highlights:
- Tranches: 1.0M (kickoff, Dec 7), 0.75M (midpoint, Dec 14), 0.5M (buffer, Dec 21)
- Conditions: runs must use the shared test harness (same dataset + sequence lengths) and the hosted Redwood endpoints. Competitors are welcome to use their own stacks but results must be generated via the shared harness for fairness.
- Data handling: logs TTL 30 days, PHI redaction rules applied; we’ll provide a short attestation for procurement to attach to the vendor packet.

Next steps: I’ll send the DocuSign for the MAP and the short redaction attestation. Please confirm the kickoff date (I’ve penciled Dec 7 at 10am PT for a 30-min ops sync).

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pilot-terms-v1.docx, mutual_action_plan_HealthA.pdf, credits_distribution.csv
